slots.metaTitle: Turn a Family Photo Into Elegant Anime Poster Art
slots.title: How to Turn Your Photo Into a Spy x Family-Inspired Custom Poster
slots.description: Learn how to turn a family photo into hand-drawn Spy x Family-inspired poster art, with photo tips, character ideas, pricing, revisions, and ordering steps.
slots.intro: A spy-themed family portrait can turn an ordinary snapshot into elegant, funny wall art with tailored outfits, warm expressions, and a little fictional intrigue. This guide explains how to order a hand-drawn [Spy x Family-inspired portrait](/portraits/spy-x-family), while our [anime gift ideas guide](/blog/spy-x-family-inspired-poster-gift-ideas) can help you choose an occasion and composition.
slots.sections: [{"heading":"What makes a Spy x Family-inspired custom poster distinctive?","blocks":[{"type":"paragraph","text":"A Spy x Family-inspired custom poster combines polished Cold War-era elegance with the affectionate chaos of family life. Think tailored suits, evening gowns, midnight-blue or burgundy colour accents, a fictional city-night setting, and expressions that look composed until the details reveal a joke. The goal is not to copy a copyrighted character or recreate a scene. Instead, you become an original character in a related visual language, with your own face, clothes, relationships, and story."},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Anime Cabinet’s artists preserve recognisable details such as hairstyles, glasses, beauty marks, smiles, and distinctive expressions. Clothing and props can then add the spy-night atmosphere: a discreet earpiece, a gala invitation, a briefcase, flowers, or a well-behaved canine companion. The finished artwork should feel like your family has joined a fictional mission, not like a cast photocopy."},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Every portrait is hand-drawn by a human artist rather than produced with an AI filter. That makes the process more personal: the artist interprets your references, follows your notes, and adjusts the composition through unlimited free revisions."}]},{"heading":"Choose the people, roles, and mood","blocks":[{"type":"paragraph","text":"Before ordering, decide what relationship and tone you want the poster to communicate. A couple might appear as undercover partners at a fictional gala, while parents and children could share a coordinated family composition with a dog as the team’s loyal companion. You can also request a best-friend duo, a solo elegant portrait, or a wedding, anniversary, housewarming, or birthday gift."},{"type":"list","items":["Family group: note each person’s preferred role, pose, expression, and position in the composition.","Couple: choose between ballroom glamour, a city-night rendezvous, or a more relaxed domestic scene.","Children: keep the mood playful and age-appropriate, with a subtle fictional mission rather than intense action.","Pets: mention the breed, size, personality, and whether your pet should appear as a Bond-style companion.","Solo portrait: request polished anime styling with a restrained smile, formal clothing, and a sophisticated background."]},{"type":"paragraph","text":"You do not need to know the exact vocabulary of the show’s visual design. Describe the feeling you want—classy, comic, romantic, mysterious, or wholesome—and include any must-have details in the order notes."}]},{"heading":"How to choose photos for a custom anime portrait from photo","blocks":[{"type":"paragraph","text":"Clear reference photos give the artist the best starting point.
